analysis.evidence: The preposition בְּ in בַּיַהְוֶה identifies YHWH as the one Abram trusted. Abram’s trust answers YHWH’s promise of offspring in the preceding verse.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וְ “and” precedes הֶאֱמִן, a Hiphil perfect, third person masculine singular. Abram is the subject.

analysis.evidence: In וְהֶאֱמִן בַּיַהְוֶה, the preposition introduces the one whom Abram trusted, Yahweh.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed preposition בַּ means “in” and precedes the proper name יַהְוֶה.
analysis.sense: Personal name of the God of Israel
